# Load data

```{r}

# SEX -> MUSS NOCH IM ANDEREN DOK GEMACHT WERDEN... 
dat <- dat %>%
  rename(sex = ADR_GenderChild) %>%
```

# H1

## H1a: well-being

```{r}
# Filter dataset
dat_rq1_wb <- dat %>%
  filter( 
    !is.na(K9_orientation), !is.na(sex), !is.na(ses)) %>%
  mutate(ses_c = (ses - mean(ses[!duplicated(person_id)])) / 10)


# model zero
m0_wb <- lmer(
  wellbeing ~ 1 + (1 | person_id),
  data = dat_rq1_wb,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(m0_wb)
icc(m0_wb)

# main model
m3_wb <- lmer(
  wellbeing ~ wave * K9_orientation + sex + ses_c +
    (1 | person_id),
  data = dat_rq1_wb,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(m3_wb)

confint(m3_wb, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")

# 1. Omnibus tests
anova(m3_wb)

# 2. Estimated marginal means
emm_wb <- emmeans(m3_wb, ~ K9_orientation | wave)
summary(emm_wb, infer = c(TRUE, FALSE))

# 3. Group differences within waves
diff_wb <- pairs(emm_wb)
summary(diff_wb, infer = c(TRUE, FALSE))

# 4. Standardized group differences

 # existing group contrasts
diff_wb_ci <- as.data.frame(summary(diff_wb, infer = c(TRUE, FALSE),adjust = "none"))
 #Calculate the model-implied total standard deviation
vc_wb <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(m3_wb))
sd_total_wb <- sqrt(sum(vc_wb$vcov))
# Calculate standardized group differences
diff_wb_ci$d <- diff_wb_ci$estimate / sd_total_wb
# Calculate approximate standardized confidence interval limits
diff_wb_ci$d_low <- diff_wb_ci$asymp.LCL / sd_total_wb
diff_wb_ci$d_up <- diff_wb_ci$asymp.UCL / sd_total_wb

diff_wb_ci

# 5. Changes in group differences across waves
change_wb <- contrast(
  diff_wb,
  method = "revpairwise",
  by = NULL
)
summary(change_wb, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), adjust = "none")

# 6. Within-group changes across assessment waves

# well-being at each wave within each orientation group
emm_wb_time <- emmeans(
  m3_wb,
  ~ wave | K9_orientation
)

# Compare waves within each orientation group
time_diff_wb <- pairs(emm_wb_time)

# within-group changes and 95% confidence intervals
summary(time_diff_wb, infer = c(TRUE, FALSE), adjust = "none")


# Übersicht Participants in this model 
# Number of participants and observations in the fitted model
model_data_wb <- dat_rq1_wb[
  as.integer(rownames(model.frame(m3_wb))), 
]

#  Unique participants by sexual orientation
model_data_wb %>%
  distinct(person_id, K9_orientation) %>%
  count(K9_orientation, name = "N_participants") %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      K9_orientation = "Total",
      N_participants = n_distinct(model_data_wb$person_id)
    )
  )

```

### Model assumptions H1a

```{r}
# create function for RQ 1 model assumptions
check_mixed_assumptions <- function(model, outcome_name) {

  # Use REML for final model diagnostics
  model <- update(model, REML = TRUE)

  # Extract model data
  dat_diag <- model.frame(model) %>%
    mutate(
      fitted = fitted(model),
      residual = residuals(model),
      std_residual = residuals(model, scaled = TRUE)
    )

  # Random intercepts
  ri <- ranef(model)$person_id[, "(Intercept)"]


  # 1. Normality

  # Level-1 residuals
  p_qq_l1 <- ggplot(
    data.frame(std_residual = dat_diag$std_residual),
    aes(sample = std_residual)
  ) +
    stat_qq(alpha = 0.4) +
    stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
    labs(
      title = "Level-1 Residuals",
      x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
      y = "Sample Quantiles"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # Random intercepts
  p_qq_l2 <- ggplot(
    data.frame(random_intercept = as.numeric(ri)),
    aes(sample = random_intercept)
  ) +
    stat_qq(alpha = 0.4) +
    stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
    labs(
      title = "Random Intercepts",
      x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
      y = "Sample Quantiles"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()


  # 2. Linearity: SES

  p_ses <- ggplot(
    dat_diag,
    aes(x = ses_c, y = residual)
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "loess",
      se = FALSE,
      color = "red"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(outcome_name, "- Residuals vs. SES"),
      x = "SES (centered)",
      y = "Residuals"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p_ses)


  # 3. Homoscedacity

  # Residuals vs. fitted
  p_fitted <- ggplot(
    dat_diag,
    aes(x = fitted, y = residual)
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "loess",
      se = FALSE,
      color = "red"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(outcome_name, "- Residuals vs. Fitted"),
      x = "Fitted Values",
      y = "Residuals"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p_fitted)


  # Residuals by wave and orientation
  p_wave <- ggplot(
    dat_diag,
    aes(
      x = wave,
      y = residual,
      fill = K9_orientation
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      alpha = 0.5,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(outcome_name, "- Residuals by Wave"),
      x = "Assessment Wave",
      y = "Residuals",
      fill = "Sexual Orientation"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p_wave)


  # 4. Level-1 Outliers

  outliers_L1 <- dat_diag %>%
    filter(abs(std_residual) > 3) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(std_residual)))

  cat("\nLEVEL-1 OUTLIERS:", outcome_name, "\n")
  cat("Number:", nrow(outliers_L1), "\n")

  print(outliers_L1)


  # 5. Level-2 Outliers

  dat_ri <- data.frame(
    person_id = rownames(ranef(model)$person_id),
    random_intercept = as.numeric(ri)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      z_intercept = as.numeric(scale(random_intercept))
    )

  outliers_L2 <- dat_ri %>%
    filter(abs(z_intercept) > 3) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(z_intercept)))

  cat("\nLEVEL-2 OUTLIERS:", outcome_name, "\n")
  cat("Number:", nrow(outliers_L2), "\n")

  print(outliers_L2)


  # 6. Influential Participants

  infl <- influence(
    model,
    group = "person_id"
  )

  cooks <- cooks.distance(infl)

 # Cook's Distance plot
  p_cooks <- ggplot(
    data.frame(
      participant = seq_along(cooks),
      cooks_distance = as.numeric(cooks)
    ),
    aes(x = participant, y = cooks_distance)
  ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(xend = participant, yend = 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Cook's Distance",
      x = "Participant",
      y = "Cook's Distance"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  cat("\nTOP 10 COOK'S DISTANCES:", outcome_name, "\n")
  print(head(sort(cooks, decreasing = TRUE), 10))


  # 7. Model Checks

  cat("\nCONVERGENCE:\n")
  print(performance::check_convergence(model))

  cat("\nSINGULARITY:\n")
  print(performance::check_singularity(model))

  cat("\nMULTICOLLINEARITY:\n")
  print(performance::check_collinearity(model))

# 8. Combine diagnostic plots
diagnostic_panel <-
  (p_qq_l1 | p_qq_l2) /
  (p_ses | p_fitted) /
  (p_wave | p_cooks) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste("Model Diagnostics -", outcome_name)
  ) &
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

# RETURN RESULTS

invisible(list(
  model = model,
  diagnostic_data = dat_diag,
  outliers_L1 = outliers_L1,
  outliers_L2 = outliers_L2,
  cooks_distance = cooks,
  influential_participants = infl,

  plots = list(
    qq_l1 = p_qq_l1,
    qq_l2 = p_qq_l2,
    ses = p_ses,
    fitted = p_fitted,
    wave = p_wave,
    cooks = p_cooks
  ),

  diagnostic_panel = diagnostic_panel
))
}

# H1a: Model assumptions 
diag_wb <- check_mixed_assumptions(
  model = m3_wb,
  outcome_name = "Well-being"
)

# Display complete diagnostic panel
diag_wb$diagnostic_panel

ggsave(
  filename = "Diagnostics_H1a.pdf",
  plot = diag_wb$diagnostic_panel,
  width = 10,
  height = 12,
  units = "in"
)

# Inspect results
diag_wb$outliers_L1
diag_wb$outliers_L2

# Top 10 influential participants
head(sort(diag_wb$cooks_distance, decreasing = TRUE), 10)

```

### Sensitivity analysis

```{r}
# H1a – SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
# Alternative sexual attraction classification (Ever-SMY)
# Same analytical sample as the main analysis


# Create alternative sexual attraction classification
# Participants are classified as non-heterosexual if they reported non-heterosexual attraction at any available wave.

orientation_person <- dat %>%
  group_by(person_id) %>%
  summarise(
    orientation_ever = case_when(
      any(
        K7_orientation == "Non-heterosexual" |
        K8_orientation == "Non-heterosexual" |
        K9_orientation == "Non-heterosexual",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) ~ "Non-heterosexual",

      any(
        K7_orientation == "Heterosexual" |
        K8_orientation == "Heterosexual" |
        K9_orientation == "Heterosexual",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) ~ "Heterosexual",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    orientation_ever = factor(
      orientation_ever,
      levels = c("Heterosexual", "Non-heterosexual")
    )
  )


# Prepare sensitivity analysis dataset

# Keep the same participants and observations
# as in the main analysis.

dat_rq1_wb_ever <- dat_rq1_wb %>%
  select(-any_of("orientation_ever")) %>%
  left_join(orientation_person, by = "person_id")

# Verify that no participants have missing Ever-SMY status
stopifnot(!anyNA(dat_rq1_wb_ever$orientation_ever))


# Compare classifications at participant level
classification_person <- dat_rq1_wb_ever %>%
  distinct(person_id, K9_orientation, orientation_ever)

# Cross-tabulation of classifications
classification_table <- table(
  K9 = classification_person$K9_orientation,
  Ever_SMY = classification_person$orientation_ever
)

classification_table

# Number of participants in each group
table(classification_person$K9_orientation)
table(classification_person$orientation_ever)



# Fit sensitivity model

model_rq1_wb_ever <- lmer(
  wellbeing ~ wave * orientation_ever +
    sex + ses_c + (1 | person_id),
  data = dat_rq1_wb_ever,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(model_rq1_wb_ever)
anova(model_rq1_wb_ever)



# Compare coefficients and 95% confidence intervals

# Extract coefficients
main <- fixef(m3_wb)
sens <- fixef(model_rq1_wb_ever)

# Extract 95% confidence intervals
ci_main <- confint(m3_wb, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald")
ci_sens <- confint(
  model_rq1_wb_ever,
  parm = "beta_",
  method = "Wald"
)

# Select group difference at K7 and interaction coefficients
terms_main <- c(
  "K9_orientationNon-heterosexual",
  "waveK8:K9_orientationNon-heterosexual",
  "waveK9:K9_orientationNon-heterosexual"
)

terms_sens <- c(
  "orientation_everNon-heterosexual",
  "waveK8:orientation_everNon-heterosexual",
  "waveK9:orientation_everNon-heterosexual"
)

# Create comparison table
comparison <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c(
    "Group difference at K7 (SMY - heterosexual)",
    "Change in group difference (K8 vs. K7)",
    "Change in group difference (K9 vs. K7)"
  ),
  Main = sprintf(
    "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
    main[terms_main],
    ci_main[terms_main, 1],
    ci_main[terms_main, 2]
  ),
  Ever_SMY = sprintf(
    "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
    sens[terms_sens],
    ci_sens[terms_sens, 1],
    ci_sens[terms_sens, 2]
  ),
  row.names = NULL
)

names(comparison) <- c(
  "Parameter",
  "Main analysis",
  "Ever-SMY classification"
)

print(comparison, row.names = FALSE)


# Compare omnibus interaction tests

anova_main <- as.data.frame(anova(m3_wb))
anova_sens <- as.data.frame(anova(model_rq1_wb_ever))

interaction_comparison <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Main analysis", "Ever-SMY classification"),
  F = round(c(
    anova_main["wave:K9_orientation", "F value"],
    anova_sens["wave:orientation_ever", "F value"]
  ), 2),
  df1 = c(
    anova_main["wave:K9_orientation", "NumDF"],
    anova_sens["wave:orientation_ever", "NumDF"]
  ),
  df2 = round(c(
    anova_main["wave:K9_orientation", "DenDF"],
    anova_sens["wave:orientation_ever", "DenDF"]
  ), 1)
)

interaction_comparison

```

## H1b: internalizing

```{r}
# Filter datased  -> HIER NOCH SCHREIBEN WIESO SES MEAN-CENTERED UND / 10 GERECHNET WURDE.. 
dat_rq1_int <- dat %>%
  filter( !is.na(K9_orientation), !is.na(sex), !is.na(ses)) %>%
  mutate(ses_c = (ses - mean(ses[!duplicated(person_id)])) / 10)


# model zero
m0_int <- lmer(
  internalizing ~ 1 + (1 | person_id),
  data = dat_rq1_int,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(m0_int)
icc(m0_int)

# main model
m3_int <- lmer(
  internalizing ~ wave * K9_orientation + sex + ses_c +
    (1 | person_id),
  data = dat_rq1_int,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(m3_int)


# 1. Omnibus tests
anova(m3_int) #### SEX WAR SIGNIFIKANT, WAS BEDEUTET DAS? ANSCHAUEN


# 2. Estimated marginal means
emm_int <- emmeans(m3_int, ~ K9_orientation | wave)
summary(emm_int, infer = c(TRUE, FALSE))


# 3. Group differences within waves
diff_int <- pairs(emm_int)
summary(diff_int, infer = c(TRUE, FALSE))


# 4. Standardized group differences

# Extract the existing group contrasts
diff_int_ci <- as.data.frame(summary(diff_int, infer = c(TRUE, FALSE), adjust = "none"))

# Calculate the model-implied total standard deviation
vc_int <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(m3_int))
sd_total_int <- sqrt(sum(vc_int$vcov))

# Calculate standardized group differences
diff_int_ci$d <- diff_int_ci$estimate / sd_total_int

# Calculate approximate standardized confidence interval limits
diff_int_ci$d_low <- diff_int_ci$asymp.LCL / sd_total_int
diff_int_ci$d_up <- diff_int_ci$asymp.UCL / sd_total_int

diff_int_ci


# 5. Changes in group differences across waves
change_int <- contrast(
  diff_int,
  method = "revpairwise",
  by = NULL
)

summary(change_int, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), adjust = "none")


# 6. Within-group changes across assessment waves
# Estimate internalizing symptoms at each wave within each orientation group
emm_int_time <- emmeans(m3_int, ~ wave | K9_orientation)

# Compare waves within each orientation group
time_diff_int <- pairs(emm_int_time)

# Display within-group changes and 95% confidence intervals
summary(time_diff_int, infer = c(TRUE, FALSE), adjust = "none")


# Übersicht über Teilnehmende
model_data_int <- dat_rq1_int[
  match(rownames(model.frame(m3_int)), rownames(dat_rq1_int)),
  , drop = FALSE
]

model_data_int %>%
  distinct(person_id, K9_orientation) %>%
  count(K9_orientation, name = "N_participants")
```

### sensitivity analysis

```{r}
# H1b – SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
# Alternative sexual attraction classification (Ever-SMY)
# Same analytical sample as the main analysis

# Prepare sensitivity analysis dataset

dat_rq1_int_ever <- dat_rq1_int %>%
  select(-any_of("orientation_ever")) %>%
  left_join(
    orientation_person %>%
      select(person_id, orientation_ever),
    by = "person_id"
  )

# Verify that no Ever-SMY classifications are missing
stopifnot(!anyNA(dat_rq1_int_ever$orientation_ever))



# Compare classifications at participant level


# Count each participant only once.

classification_person_int <- dat_rq1_int_ever %>%
  distinct(person_id, K9_orientation, orientation_ever)

# Cross-tabulation
classification_table_int <- table(
  K9 = classification_person_int$K9_orientation,
  Ever_SMY = classification_person_int$orientation_ever
)

classification_table_int

# Number of participants in each group
table(classification_person_int$K9_orientation)
table(classification_person_int$orientation_ever)



# Fit sensitivity model


model_rq1_int_ever <- lmer(
  internalizing ~ wave * orientation_ever +
    sex + ses_c + (1 | person_id),
  data = dat_rq1_int_ever,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(model_rq1_int_ever)
anova(model_rq1_int_ever)



# Compare coefficients and 95% confidence intervals


# Extract fixed-effect coefficients
main_int <- fixef(m3_int)
sens_int <- fixef(model_rq1_int_ever)

# Extract 95% confidence intervals
ci_main_int <- confint(
  m3_int,
  parm = "beta_",
  method = "Wald"
)

ci_sens_int <- confint(
  model_rq1_int_ever,
  parm = "beta_",
  method = "Wald"
)

# Select group difference at K7 and interaction coefficients
terms_main_int <- c(
  "K9_orientationNon-heterosexual",
  "waveK8:K9_orientationNon-heterosexual",
  "waveK9:K9_orientationNon-heterosexual"
)

terms_sens_int <- c(
  "orientation_everNon-heterosexual",
  "waveK8:orientation_everNon-heterosexual",
  "waveK9:orientation_everNon-heterosexual"
)

# Create comparison table
comparison_int <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c(
    "Group difference at K7 (SMY - heterosexual)",
    "Change in group difference (K8 vs. K7)",
    "Change in group difference (K9 vs. K7)"
  ),
  Main = sprintf(
    "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
    main_int[terms_main_int],
    ci_main_int[terms_main_int, 1],
    ci_main_int[terms_main_int, 2]
  ),
  Ever_SMY = sprintf(
    "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
    sens_int[terms_sens_int],
    ci_sens_int[terms_sens_int, 1],
    ci_sens_int[terms_sens_int, 2]
  ),
  row.names = NULL
)

names(comparison_int) <- c(
  "Parameter",
  "Main analysis",
  "Ever-SMY classification"
)

print(comparison_int, row.names = FALSE)



# Compare omnibus interaction tests


anova_main_int <- as.data.frame(anova(m3_int))
anova_sens_int <- as.data.frame(anova(model_rq1_int_ever))

interaction_comparison_int <- data.frame(
  Model = c(
    "Main analysis",
    "Ever-SMY classification"
  ),
  F = round(c(
    anova_main_int["wave:K9_orientation", "F value"],
    anova_sens_int["wave:orientation_ever", "F value"]
  ), 2),
  df1 = c(
    anova_main_int["wave:K9_orientation", "NumDF"],
    anova_sens_int["wave:orientation_ever", "NumDF"]
  ),
  df2 = round(c(
    anova_main_int["wave:K9_orientation", "DenDF"],
    anova_sens_int["wave:orientation_ever", "DenDF"]
  ), 1)
)

interaction_comparison_int
```

```{r}
# K7 Well-being as baseline for each participant
baseline_wb <- dat %>%
  filter(wave == "K7") %>%
  select(person_id, wellbeing_K7 = wellbeing)

# join 
dat_rq2_wb <- dat %>%
  left_join(baseline_wb, by = "person_id")

nrow(dat_rq2_wb)

# CHECK if a participant needs more than one row
baseline_wb %>% count(person_id) %>% filter(n > 1)

# select complete cases
dat_rq2_wb_k9 <- dat_rq2_wb %>%
  filter(wave == "K9") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(wellbeing),
    !is.na(wellbeing_K7),
    !is.na(K7_ResilFriends),
    !is.na(K9_orientation),

  mutate(ses_c = (ses - mean(ses[!duplicated(person_id)])) / 10)

    wb_K7_c = wellbeing_K7 -

  )

# Base model

  wellbeing ~ wb_K7_c +

)

# Interactionmodel
model_rq2_wb_mod <- lm(
  wellbeing ~ wb_K7_c +
    peer_c * K9_orientation + sex + ses_c,
  data = dat_rq2_wb_k9
)

# Cohens D

summary(model_rq2_wb_mod)$r.squared

# adjusted R²
summary(model_rq2_wb_base)$adj.r.squared
summary(model_rq2_wb_mod)$adj.r.squared

# additionally explained value

  summary(model_rq2_wb_mod)$r.squared -
  summary(model_rq2_wb_base)$r.squared

delta_R2
```

### Model assumptions

```{r}
diagnose_rq2 <- function(model_base, model_mod,
                         baseline_var, outcome_name) {

  # Extract model data
  dat <- model.frame(model_mod)

  std_res <- rstandard(model_mod)
  res <- residuals(model_mod)
  fit <- fitted(model_mod)
  cd <- cooks.distance(model_mod)

  threshold <- 4 / nobs(model_mod)

  diag_data <- data.frame(
    fitted = fit,
    residual = res,
    std_res = std_res,
    sqrt_abs_res = sqrt(abs(std_res))
  )

  # 1. Q-Q plot
  p_qq <- ggplot(diag_data, aes(sample = std_res)) +
    stat_qq(alpha = 0.4) +
    stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
    labs(title = "Q-Q Plot: Residuals") +
    theme_minimal()

  # 2. Residual distribution
  p_hist <- ggplot(diag_data, aes(x = std_res)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 35, fill = "steelblue") +
    labs(
      title = "Residual Distribution",
      x = "Standardized Residuals",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # 3. Residuals vs. fitted
  p_fitted <- ggplot(
    diag_data, aes(x = fitted, y = residual)
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE,
                color = "red") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
      title = "Residuals vs. Fitted",
      x = "Fitted Values",
      y = "Residuals"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # 4. Scale-location
  p_scale <- ggplot(
    diag_data, aes(x = fitted, y = sqrt_abs_res)
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE,
                color = "red") +
    labs(
      title = "Scale-Location",
      x = "Fitted Values",
      y = "Sqrt(|Standardized Residuals|)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # 5. Cook's distance
  p_cooks <- ggplot(
    data.frame(obs = seq_along(cd), cooks = cd),
    aes(x = obs, y = cooks)
  ) +
    geom_segment(aes(xend = obs, yend = 0)) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = threshold,
      color = "red",
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Cook's Distance",
      x = "Observation",
      y = "Cook's Distance"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # 6. Peer support by orientation
  p_coverage <- ggplot(
    dat, aes(x = peer_c, fill = K9_orientation)
  ) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
    facet_wrap(~ K9_orientation) +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    labs(
      title = "Peer Support by Orientation",
      x = "Peer Support (centered)",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # 7. Component-plus-residual plots
  make_cr <- function(variable) {
    local_model <- model_base
    local_variable <- variable

    ggplotify::as.ggplot(
      function() {
        car::crPlot(
          local_model,
          variable = local_variable
        )
      }
    )
  }

  p_cr_baseline <- make_cr(baseline_var)
  p_cr_peer <- make_cr("peer_c")
  p_cr_ses <- make_cr("ses_c")

# 8. Combine plots – 4 rows x 2 columns
panel <- (
  p_qq | p_fitted
) / (
  p_scale | p_cooks
) / (
  p_coverage | p_cr_baseline
) / (
  p_cr_peer | p_cr_ses
) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste("Model Diagnostics –", outcome_name)
  )

  print(panel)

  # 9. Outliers and influential observations
  outliers <- which(abs(std_res) > 3)

  cat("\nOUTLIERS |standardized residual| > 3:\n")
  print(outliers)

  cat("\nCOOK'S DISTANCE:\n")
  cat("Threshold:", threshold, "\n")
  cat("Cases above 4/n:", sum(cd > threshold), "\n")

  print(head(sort(cd, decreasing = TRUE), 10))

  # 10. Multicollinearity
  cat("\nVIF – Base model:\n")
  print(car::vif(model_base))

  cat("\nVIF – Interaction model:\n")
  print(car::vif(model_mod))

  invisible(list(
    panel = panel,
    outliers = outliers,
    cooks_distance = cd,
    excluded_4n = which(cd > threshold)
  ))
}



# H2a: Well-being

  model_rq2_wb_base,
  model_rq2_wb_mod,
  "wb_K7_c",
  "Well-being"
)

  "diagnostics_H2a.pdf",
  plot = diag_h2a$panel,
  width = 15,
  height = 18,
  units = "in"
)
```

```{r}
)
```

### Sensitivity Analyses

```{r}
# Sensitivity analyses: Influential observations (H2b)

# Cook's distance
cd_int <- cooks.distance(model_rq2_int_mod)

# Most influential observation
top1_int <- which.max(cd_int)

# Threshold: Cook's D > 4/n
threshold_int <- 4 / nobs(model_rq2_int_mod)

# Number of observations above threshold
sum(cd_int > threshold_int)


# Model excluding the most influential observation
model_int_without1 <- update(
  model_rq2_int_mod,
  data = model.frame(model_rq2_int_mod)[
    -top1_int, , drop = FALSE
  ]
)

# Model excluding all observations above 4/n
model_int_without4n <- update(
  model_rq2_int_mod,
  data = model.frame(model_rq2_int_mod)[
    cd_int <= threshold_int, , drop = FALSE
  ]
)

# Compare interaction coefficients
c(
  full = coef(model_rq2_int_mod)["peer_c:K9_orientationNon-heterosexual"],
  without1 = coef(model_int_without1)["peer_c:K9_orientationNon-heterosexual"],
  without4n = coef(model_int_without4n)["peer_c:K9_orientationNon-heterosexual"]
)

# Compare 95% confidence intervals
rbind(
  full = confint(model_rq2_int_mod)["peer_c:K9_orientationNon-heterosexual", ],
  without1 = confint(model_int_without1)["peer_c:K9_orientationNon-heterosexual", ],
  without4n = confint(model_int_without4n)["peer_c:K9_orientationNon-heterosexual", ]
)


# Number of observations in each model
nobs(model_rq2_int_mod)     # Full sample
nobs(model_int_without1)    # Excluding most influential observation
nobs(model_int_without4n)   # Excluding observations with Cook's D > 4/n
```

```{r}
  ),
  CI_upper = c(
    confint(model_rq2_int_mod)[main_term, 2],
    confint(model_rq2_int_ever)[ever_term, 2]
  )
)

comparison_h2b

# Internalizing symptoms SMY Confidence intervals
emtrends(
  model_rq2_int_ever,
  specs = ~ orientation_ever,
  var = "peer_c"
) %>%
  confint()


# Internalizing symptoms: Model without interaction
model_rq2_int_ever_main <- update(
  model_rq2_int_ever,
  . ~ . - peer_c:orientation_ever
)

# Additional variance explained by interaction
delta_r2_int_ever <-
  summary(model_rq2_int_ever)$r.squared -
  summary(model_rq2_int_ever_main)$r.squared

delta_r2_int_ever
```

### Model assumptions

```{r}
diagnose_rq3 <- function(model_base, model_mod, outcome_name) {

  # 0. Extract diagnostic data
  model_data <- model.frame(model_mod)

  std_res <- rstandard(model_mod)
  cd <- cooks.distance(model_mod)
  threshold <- 4 / nobs(model_mod)

  dat_diag <- data.frame(
    fitted = fitted(model_mod),
    residual = residuals(model_mod),
    std_res = std_res,
    sqrt_abs_res = sqrt(abs(std_res)),
    cooks = cd,
    observation = seq_along(cd)
  )

  # 1. Q-Q plot
  p_qq <- ggplot(dat_diag, aes(sample = std_res)) +
    stat_qq(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
    stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
    labs(
      title = "Q-Q Plot: Residuals",
      x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
      y = "Sample Quantiles"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # 2. Residuals vs. fitted
  p_fitted <- ggplot(
    dat_diag,
    aes(x = fitted, y = residual)
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "loess",
      se = FALSE,
      color = "red"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Residuals vs. Fitted",
      x = "Fitted Values",
      y = "Residuals"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # 3. Scale-location
  p_scale <- ggplot(
    dat_diag,
    aes(x = fitted, y = sqrt_abs_res)
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "loess",
      se = FALSE,
      color = "red"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Scale-Location",
      x = "Fitted Values",
      y = "Sqrt(|Standardized Residuals|)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # 4. Cook's distance
  p_cooks <- ggplot(
    dat_diag,
    aes(x = observation, y = cooks)
  ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(xend = observation, yend = 0),
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = threshold,
      color = "red",
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Cook's Distance",
      x = "Observation",
      y = "Cook's Distance"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # 5. Component-plus-residual plots
  # Based on main-effects model

  make_cr <- function(variable) {
    ggplotify::as.ggplot(
      function() {
        car::crPlot(
          model_base,
          variable = variable )}) }

  p_cr_victim <- make_cr("victim_c")
  p_cr_peer <- make_cr("peer_c")
  p_cr_ses <- make_cr("ses_c")

  # 6. Predictor coverage
  p_coverage <- ggplot(
    model_data,
    aes(x = victim_c, y = peer_c)
  ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.03,
      height = 0.03,
      alpha = 0.3,
      size = 0.8
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Predictor Coverage",
      x = "Bullying Victimization (centered)",
      y = "Peer Support (centered)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  # 7. Combine plots: 4 rows x 2 columns
  panel <- (
    p_qq | p_fitted
  ) / (
    p_scale | p_cooks
  ) / (
    p_cr_victim | p_cr_peer
  ) / (
    p_cr_ses | p_coverage
  ) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = paste("Model Diagnostics –", outcome_name)
    )

  panel <- panel &
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 11,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )

  print(panel)

  # 8. Outliers
  outliers <- which(abs(std_res) > 3)

  cat("\nOBSERVATIONS WITH |STANDARDIZED RESIDUAL| > 3:\n")
  print(outliers)

  # 9. Influential observations
  cat("\nCOOK'S DISTANCE:\n")
  cat("Threshold (4/n):", threshold, "\n")
  cat("Observations above 4/n:", sum(cd > threshold), "\n")

  cat("\n10 largest Cook's distances:\n")
  print(head(sort(cd, decreasing = TRUE), 10))

  # 10. Multicollinearity
  cat("\nVIF – Base model:\n")
  print(car::vif(model_base))

  cat("\nVIF – Interaction model:\n")
  print(car::vif(model_mod))

  # 11. Return diagnostic results
  invisible(list(
    panel = panel,
    cooks_distance = cd,
    outliers = outliers,
    excluded_4n = which(cd > threshold)
  ))
}

# H3a: Wellbeing
diag_h3a <- diagnose_rq3(
  model_base = model_rq3_wb_base,
  model_mod = model_rq3_wb_mod,
  outcome_name = "Well-being"
)

# save pdf
ggsave(
  "diagnostics_H3a.pdf",
  plot = diag_h3a$panel,
  width = 10,
  height = 14,
  units = "in"
)

```

### Sensitivity Analyses

```{r}
# H3a: Sensitivity analysis – influential observations

# Cook's Distance
cd_wb <- cooks.distance(model_rq3_wb_mod)
threshold_wb <- 4 / nobs(model_rq3_wb_mod)

# Identify influential observations
top1_wb <- which.max(cd_wb)
excluded_wb <- which(cd_wb > threshold_wb)

# Number of observations above 4/n
length(excluded_wb)


# 1. Model without most influential observation
model_wb_without1 <- update(
  model_rq3_wb_mod,
  data = model.frame(model_rq3_wb_mod)[
    -top1_wb, , drop = FALSE
  ]
)

# 2. Model without observations above 4/n
model_wb_without4n <- update(
  model_rq3_wb_mod,
  data = model.frame(model_rq3_wb_mod)[
    cd_wb <= threshold_wb, , drop = FALSE
  ]
)


# Compare interaction coefficients
c(
  full = coef(model_rq3_wb_mod)["victim_c:peer_c"],
  without1 = coef(model_wb_without1)["victim_c:peer_c"],
  without4n = coef(model_wb_without4n)["victim_c:peer_c"]
)

# Compare confidence intervals
rbind(
  full = confint(model_rq3_wb_mod)["victim_c:peer_c", ],
  without1 = confint(model_wb_without1)["victim_c:peer_c", ],
  without4n = confint(model_wb_without4n)["victim_c:peer_c", ]
)


# 3. Inspect most influential observation
model_data_wb <- model.frame(model_rq3_wb_mod)

# Match model rows to original dataset
case_wb <- dat_rq3_wb_smy[
  match(rownames(model_data_wb),
        rownames(dat_rq3_wb_smy)), ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Most influential person
case_wb[top1_wb, c(
  "person_id",
  "K7_BullVict4",
  "K7_ResilFriends",
  "wellbeing",
  "sex",
  "ses"
)]

# Diagnostic values for this person
data.frame(
  cooks_d = cd_wb[top1_wb],
  leverage = hatvalues(model_rq3_wb_mod)[top1_wb],
  std_residual = rstandard(model_rq3_wb_mod)[top1_wb],
  dfbetas_interaction =
    dfbetas(model_rq3_wb_mod)[
      top1_wb, "victim_c:peer_c"
    ]
)


# 4. Inspect all observations above 4/n
excluded_cases_wb <- case_wb[excluded_wb, c(
  "person_id",
  "K7_BullVict4",
  "K7_ResilFriends",
  "wellbeing"
)]

excluded_cases_wb$cooks_d <- cd_wb[excluded_wb]

excluded_cases_wb$dfbetas_interaction <-
  dfbetas(model_rq3_wb_mod)[
    excluded_wb, "victim_c:peer_c"
  ]

excluded_cases_wb[
  order(excluded_cases_wb$cooks_d, decreasing = TRUE),
]
```

## H3b: internalizing

```{r}
# H3b: Cross-sectional moderation analysis at K7
# K7-Datensatz mit vollständigen Modellvariablen – nur SMY
dat_rq3_int_smy <- dat %>%
  filter(
    wave == "K7",
    K9_orientation == "Non-heterosexual",
    !is.na(internalizing),
    !is.na(K7_BullVict4),
    !is.na(K7_ResilFriends),
    !is.na(sex),
    !is.na(ses)) %>%
  mutate(
    # SES: 10-Punkte-Einheiten
    ses_c = (ses - mean(ses)) / 10,

    # Viktimisierung zentrieren
    victim_c = K7_BullVict4 - mean(K7_BullVict4),

    # Peer Support zentrieren
    peer_c = K7_ResilFriends - mean(K7_ResilFriends))

# Stichprobengrösse
nrow(dat_rq3_int_smy)

# Prüfen, ob jede Person nur einmal vorkommt
dat_rq3_int_smy %>%
  count(person_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

# Deskriptive Statistiken
summary(dat_rq3_int_smy[
  c("internalizing", "K7_BullVict4",
    "K7_ResilFriends", "ses")])


# Main effects
model_rq3_int_base <- lm(
  internalizing ~ victim_c + peer_c + sex + ses_c,
  data = dat_rq3_int_smy)

summary(model_rq3_int_base)


# MODEL 2: Victimization × Peer Support
model_rq3_int_mod <- lm(
  internalizing ~ victim_c * peer_c + sex + ses_c,
  data = dat_rq3_int_smy)

summary(model_rq3_int_mod)

# Standardisierte Regressionskoeffizienten
parameters::standardize_parameters(
  model_rq3_int_mod,
  method = "refit")

# 95%-Konfidenzintervalle
confint(model_rq3_int_base)
confint(model_rq3_int_mod)


# MODEL FIT
# R²
summary(model_rq3_int_base)$r.squared
summary(model_rq3_int_mod)$r.squared

# Adjustiertes R²
summary(model_rq3_int_base)$adj.r.squared
summary(model_rq3_int_mod)$adj.r.squared

# Zusätzlich erklärte Varianz durch die Interaktion
delta_R2_int <-
  summary(model_rq3_int_mod)$r.squared -
  summary(model_rq3_int_base)$r.squared

delta_R2_int

# Modellvergleich
anova(model_rq3_int_base, model_rq3_int_mod)

# included participants
dat_rq3_int_smy %>%
  distinct(person_id, K9_orientation) %>%
  count(K9_orientation, name = "N_participants")
```
